warnings: Two small plans drawn above the third-floor plan, each aligned with a stair bay (column lines dropped from grids 4/5 and 17/18 into the main plan). The box is 2.50 deep by scale, i.e. the A-B span of the stair bay, so it is recorded on A-B x 4-5 and A-B x 17-18. The platform level is not printed here ('ดูรูปตัด').
The marks B3 / B4 reuse floor-beam marks; the slab mark ST is the slab detailed as ST on S-12 (L=2.50x4.00, matching this bay).
